extracted.intended_audience: education researchers, grant program analysts, and policymakers interested in historical funding for in-service/summer institutes for secondary school teachers
extracted.subtask_description: A catalog-style listing of awarded in-service, summer, and academic-year institutes and other program grants for secondary-school teacher professional development, showing project director, institution, project title/topic, award code, duration (months), and dollar amount. Useful for analysis of historical funding distribution by topic, institution, and state.
